prose: Basis: Bloomberg blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Anthropic's S-1 discloses an $80.7 billion net loss on revenue of $16.3 billion for the first half of 2026, against a $13 billion net loss on $1.2 billion of revenue in the same period of 2025. Revenue grew more than thirteen-fold year over year, and net revenue retention is reported at 900%. The filing warns the technology carries existential risks even as the company moves closer to the market.

H1 2025 comparison: a $13B net loss on $1.2B of revenue
